Emily —

Thanks for the workbook and the timeline constraint. Per our internal alignment (notes attached) please find the Redwood MAP v1 attached (Redwood_MAP_v1.pdf). High-level summary below: 

Phase A — Pilot (1 week)
- Scope: 2 internal teams (support + dev sandbox), low traffic (<=2% of target TPS)
- Success gates: no P95 latency regression >250ms; no functional regressions on the clinical-summary prompt set; operational runbook validated.

Phase B — Canary (10 business days)
- 3-day smoke: health checks, e2e verification
- 5-day monitored ramp: step traffic 5% -> 25% -> 50% with daily metric review
- 2-day stabilization: final acceptance window; if any regression triggers, automatic rollback to hosted variant and pause migration.

Phase C — Migration & Training (2 weeks total overlap)
- Training: two live 90-min workshops (admin + dev), one recorded deep-dive for QA
- Migration window: scheduled overnight cutovers on low-traffic days; final migration target week starting 2028-08-05 to avoid your 8/15 freeze.

Evaluation plan:
- Acceptance test suite (attached) with three prioritized prompt sets (clinical-summary, billing-normalization, customer-chat). We will compare p50/p95 latency, per-token cost delta, and quality regression score (human-Eval checklist) against the agreed baseline.

Operational items and links:
- Runbook & playbooks: https://docs.redwood.ai/s/Varix-VX456-MAP-v1
- HubSpot record: HS-934572

Attached: Redwood_MAP_v1.pdf (signed draft), proposed_canary_schedule.csv (internal cadence).

Next steps: please confirm acceptance of the MAP by 2028-07-06. Once confirmed we'll lock the canary start date (we recommend week of 2028-07-15) and provision a dedicated test pool. Procurement note: this MAP will be appended to the SOW as Exhibit B per our contract.

If you want a short call to walk through the canary metrics dashboard, I can set 30 minutes on 07/05.
